title: Custom Wrestling Uniforms (2026)
verdict: For custom wrestling uniforms in 2026, Wooter is where to start. Its singlets are fully sublimated in your design, the minimum is one, delivery is three to four weeks, and shorts and outerwear come from the same catalog.

Cliff Keen is the specialist to compare, with singlets made in Ann Arbor, Michigan. All Sports Uniforms sells DAWG singlets with fast rush options. Boombah offers sublimated wrestling uniforms alongside its other sports.

ranking.fit: School teams and clubs that want singlets, warmups and bags designed together, with no minimum.
ranking.lacks: Three to four weeks standard. If the season starts next week, look for a rush.
ranking.note: Wooter's singlets use a 310gsm polyester-spandex fabric, with a lighter 260gsm option.

ranking.fit: Programs that want singlets made in Ann Arbor, Michigan, with men's, women's and international cuts.
ranking.lacks: A minimum of six on most custom products, and 3 to 5 weeks after art approval.

ranking.fit: Teams that want DAWG singlets from an online builder, with one and two week rush when the season is close.
ranking.lacks: Small orders of women's singlets carry a per-singlet fee.

ranking.fit: Teams already buying Boombah for other sports that want a sublimated singlet from the same maker.
ranking.lacks: Wrestling is a small part of what it makes.

why: A wrestling uniform is one garment doing a hard job. It has to stay put through a six-minute match, show the team's colors and survive being washed after every practice.
Sublimation is the standard for a reason. The design is in the fabric, so there is nothing to crack when the singlet stretches.
Wooter designs it for free, and sizing kits are available so wrestlers can check fit before the order.

faq.q: What counts as a legal wrestling uniform?
faq.a: A singlet is the standard. Many associations also allow a two-piece uniform of a compression shirt and shorts. Check your rulebook.
One at Wooter on most items. Cliff Keen sets a minimum of six on most custom products.

faq.q: How long do custom singlets take?
faq.a: Three to four weeks at Wooter. Cliff Keen usually ships within 3 to 5 weeks of art approval. All Sports Uniforms lists three weeks with rush options.

faq.q: Do you make girls' and women's singlets?
faq.a: Wooter publishes a girls' singlet guide and makes singlets for girls' teams. Cliff Keen and All Sports Uniforms both list women's cuts.
Yes. Order them in the same design.
